# Third-party licences

The builds contain open-source code by others. Each package carries its
notices beside the game (`THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt`; on the PS5 also
`LEGAL.txt`); these are copies of them, as the latest release ships them.

| Platform | Notices |
| --- | --- |
| Windows, Linux | [windows-linux.txt](windows-linux.txt) |
| macOS | [macos.txt](macos.txt) |
| Android | [android.txt](android.txt) |
| iOS | [ios.txt](ios.txt) |
| PS5 | [ps5-LEGAL.txt](ps5-LEGAL.txt) (the title's C and C++ libraries: Mesa's RADV, musl's regex, LLVM's runtime) and [ps5.txt](ps5.txt) (the Rust crates) |

They cover the code only. The game's own engine is under [LICENSE](../LICENSE),
and a release's mods carry their own credits (`ATTRIBUTION.txt`, `LICENSE`)
in their folders.
